free_tier_rate_limits_note: Google AI Studio enforces free-tier limits per project (dynamic in AI Studio -> Rate Limits). Typical free-tier envelopes: Flash-Lite ~15 RPM / 250k TPM / 500-1000 RPD; Flash (thinking) ~10 RPM / 250k TPM / 250-500 RPD; thinking tokens count toward output tokens. FINN stays well inside this by: (1) rules-first classification (~40% handled by Stage-1 rules with 0 LLM calls), (2) batching remaining announcements up to 20 per call, and (3) sha256 content-hash caching.
